name: Kew Mar Pan Café

sources.ref: The record's own crawled description reads 'First aid room' — a first-aid point at a mountain-road café (18.5554, 98.4819, Mae Chaem side), typed healthcare on the wrong door. The name is the café's; nothing about the place is a hospital. The first-aid description stays on the record.
